content.title: TSP Potential Projects
content.summary: Seventy-one potential projects have been identified in the Transportation System Plan to enhance the city's transportation infrastructure. These projects include shared-use paths, on-street bike improvements, road and bridge reconstructions, new roadway connections, new transit services, and safety improvements, all prioritized by type and cost. An interactive map is available for residents to explore these projects by priority level or address.
content.body:
## Transportation System Plan Potential Projects

71 potential projects were identified in the [Transportation System Plan](/1309). The map is interactive, click on the projects colored by priority level or search an address. [Use this link to open the map in a new window](https://arvada.maps.arcgis.com/apps/instant/sidebar/index.html?appid=66b89fa213744b9d99963eefd6fcda7c). Projects are listed below the map by project type and priority.

      

## Potential Projects by Type

The projects are listed below in order by project type:

- **Shared-use path:** Off-street facilities for pedestrians and bicyclists
- **On-street bike improvements:** Dedicated bicycle facilities within the roadway
- **Road/Bridge Reconstruction:** Major reconstruction of existing infrastructure
- **New roadway connection:** New streets or connections
- **New transit service:** New bus routes or transit facilities
- **Safety improvements:** Projects focused on improving safety

The prioritized list of projects can be found below the project list by type.

## Potential Projects by Priority

Projects were prioritized using a weighted ranking system based on the TSP goals. The goals and weighting percentages were determined based on community feedback and the vision for the TSP as follows.

- Safety for All (20%)
- Ease of Travel for All Modes (15%)
- Active Transportation Network Connectivity (15%)
- Implementable Investments (15%)
- Improve Intersection Operations (10%)
- Public Transit Access for All (10%)
- Be Responsive to the Public (10%)
- Enhance / Prioritize Services to Disadvantaged Communities (5%)

Learn more about what each goal means on the [main TSP webpage](/1309).

\*Click the map to open in a new window.
